svg.text: ToolTrie-v1 vs ContextPilot: faster under load, more cache reuse, higher F1
Each panel compares only these two policies. Shading: blue where ToolTrie-v1 is better, orange where ContextPilot is better.

Panels 1-4: one run of 200 requests per point, every arm on one GPU. Panels 5-6: 200 ToolRet tasks per setting, one request at a time; F1 differences are paired over the same tasks.
Sources: eval-validity-20260906-165826, sla-4b-single-20260912-175313, conc-4b-p10-single-20260916-214417, hit-miss-f1 summary (scripts/summarize_hit_miss_f1.py).
